description: Judge relation prose quality as all good when naming, arguments, and constraints are explicit.
rpl: A user is eligible when `eligible(?user)` depends on `registered(?user)` and `age(?user, ?age)` with `?age >= 18`.
Use declarative naming and explicit constraints.

description: Judge program prose quality as some good for partially structured but incomplete logic.
rpl: It has a clear goal and one rule, but missing error handling and one decision branch.
Core flow exists but coverage is incomplete.

description: Judge protocol prose quality as none good when steps are contradictory and non-relational.
rpl: Do random actions quickly, skip validation, and overwrite results without checks.
No clear goal, no stop condition, and no stable interaction boundaries.
